self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Gladiator (R5): if there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK +16% and DEF +16%. If fewer than 2 opponents are nearby, ATK +24%.

en.flavor: A sharp crimson polearm that was once a gladiator's priceless treasure. Its awl has been stained by the blood of countless beasts and men.

refinements.1: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>16%</r> and DEF is increased by <r>16%</r>. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>24%</r>.
refinements.2: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>20%</r> and DEF is increased by <r>20%</r>. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>30%</r>.
refinements.3: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>24%</r> and DEF is increased by <r>24%</r>. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>36%</r>.
refinements.4: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>28%</r> and DEF is increased by <r>28%</r>. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>42%</r>.
refinements.5: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>32%</r> and DEF is increased by <r>32%</r>. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <r>48%</r>.

fr.flavor: Une lance rouge tranchante qui fut autrefois l'arme chérie d'un gladiateur. Le sang d'innombrables ennemis, hommes et bêtes, a teinté sa lame.

refinements.1: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>16 %</r> et la DÉF de <r>16 %</r> si 2 ennemis ou plus se trouvent à proximité ; augmente l'ATQ de <r>24 %</r> dans le cas contraire.

refinements.3: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>24 %</r> et la DÉF de <r>24 %</r> si 2 ennemis ou plus se trouvent à proximité ; augmente l'ATQ de <r>36 %</r> dans le cas contraire.
refinements.4: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>28 %</r> et la DÉF de <r>28 %</r> si 2 ennemis ou plus se trouvent à proximité ; augmente l'ATQ de <r>42 %</r> dans le cas contraire.
refinements.5: Augmente l'ATQ de <r>32 %</r> et la DÉF de <r>32 %</r> si 2 ennemis ou plus se trouvent à proximité ; augmente l'ATQ de <r>48 %</r> dans le cas contraire.
